When is the best time to visit the Algarve? (month-by-month guide)
item.description: In my opinion the best time to visit the Algarve is April–May and September–October. These months offer warm sunshine, fewer crowds, nice temperatures, and better prices than summer, making them ideal for most travelers. That said, the “best” time really depends on what you want from your trip. Below is a clear breakdown by season, interests, and month. item.description: If you’re looking for the ultimate coastal hike in the Algarve, let me introduce you to the 7 Hanging Valleys Trail. This stunning coastal trek is often ranked as one of the best hiking routes in Europe, and trust me, it’s easy to see why!
